name: Indicator coverage
detail: 152 of 156 (snapshot, indicator) pairs in the metadata have data; 4 are listed in the metadata but return no rows from the API.

name: Indicator grain is unique
detail: indicator_values is unique on snapshot x indicator x series x org x area x disaggregations x period.

name: `results` view has one row per snapshot x indicator x org x area
detail: Safe to aggregate or join without double counting.

name: Every indicator has a headline series
detail: All WBG Results indicators resolve to exactly one headline series per snapshot. 6 Client Context/Vision indicators publish only component series (e.g. water, sanitation and hygiene separately); use their sub-indicators.

name: Base values agree with display values
detail: 100.00% of rows: base value = display value x unit multiplier (K/M/B; MW display of GW base; GHG rescaled from tCO2eq to MtCO2eq), within rounding. The pipeline uses base values throughout.

name: Institution hierarchy (never sum across org_code)
detail: WBG = WB + IFC + MIGA holds within 0.5% for 45 of 45 indicator-snapshots (global, achieved; economy counts are excluded because one economy can be supported by several institutions). IBRD + IDA exceeds WB in 12 cases (projects with both IBRD and IDA financing are counted once in WB), so IBRD and IDA must never be summed.

name: Regional rows add up to the global total
detail: Regions (incl. 'Other') sum to the global total (ACW) within 2% in 50 of 51 cases. Country rows cover a median 99.7% of the global total; the rest is from multi-country/regional operations. Use ACW for global totals, never the sum of countries.

name: Result country codes match the country dimension
detail: 59 snapshot-specific codes filed under COUNTRY are multi-country groupings (e.g. 1W World, 3A Africa) or legacy codes; `country_results.is_economy` flags them so country rankings can exclude them.

name: Negative values
detail: Negative values for GHG indicators are expected (net reductions / net removals). 2 other negative value(s) look like source errors and are left as published: CSC_RES_GEN_EQU_BENE

name: Project-level data reconciles to WB totals
detail: 3158 distinct World Bank (IBRD/IDA) projects; IFC and MIGA report only aggregates. Summed project expected values match the WB global total within 2% for 45 of 50 indicator-snapshots. The rest are listed below: project drill-downs for these are not exhaustive.
